_about: The Magic Portals port's portal shot. The owner said on 11 September that a tap fires a
shot from the character toward the tap, and the portal opens where it arrives. A wall, a
crate or a stone on the way stops it, and a shot that fails costs nothing. The remake
opens a portal at the tap at once, so this is the port's. See

_note: How fast a shot flies. The original's script has the shot (portal_launch,
projectileDir, projectilePos) but its speed is not decoded, and nobody measured it.
What a reflect_agent does to a shot. The owner said on 11 September that it reflects
the shot 'under an angle', and did not know how far it goes on; they will judge that by
playing. So the shot comes off mirrored across the reflector's plane and goes on for the
rest of the distance it was fired: a flat reflector sends it to the tap mirrored across
it. reflect_agent.ent has no collision (shape 0) and no size, so how near a shot has to
pass is not the original's either: half its 32 px sprite. The original's script keeps
a hasBeenReflected flag, not a count, so a shot comes off one reflector at most.
_default_plane: The plane of a reflector whose level gives none. One placement in the game does:
level26a's reflect_agent_ent_961. reflect_agent.ent carries no default, and the remake
reads a missing plane as vertical (behaviours.gd:246), so the port does too.
